text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I stopped by a bookstore to browse for training manuals—
and happened to spot Air Messiah.
choice_data_list: (Is she looking at reference books, maybe...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how diligent Air Messiah always was,
that was naturally the first thought that crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Trainer.
Are you out shopping?
choice_data_list: Yeah, looking for training books. What about you?
Yep, looking for training manuals. And you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A manga volume. Since it is my day off,
I thought I would relax and read in my room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That makes total sense, I thought.
It's a choice very characteristic of someone who takes rest seriously.
choice_data_list: Sounds like a great way to unwind.
Sounds like a lovely way to unwind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I believe it will provide meaningful recuperation.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What about yourself, Trainer?
How do you intend to spend your rest today?
choice_data_list: Huh, me?
Eh, me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rest—I hadn't actually thought about resting at all.
In fact, I might not even have a real grasp on the concept of 'rest' to begin with...
choice_data_list: I haven't really... decided...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you have nothing planned?
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there is a place I was intending to stop by next.
Would you care to accompany me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Air Messiah's suggestion, we arrived at a general goods shop.
She was gazing intently at a small object nestled inside glassware.
choice_data_list: What is that?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: A moss terrarium—commonly known as a mossarium.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I cultivate them in my room on a regular basis.
I came here today in search of new decorations.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... this volcanic rock has a lovely hue. And this pumice here—
—Oh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, what an adorable shape.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What caught her eye was a slender,
tiny piece of driftwood with a curled tip.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The size is just right, and the color is lovely too...
It should pair wonderfully with the one I am currently growing.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, I shall take this one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle smile escaped her lips without her even realizing.
Her expression was brighter, more relaxed, and softer than usual.
choice_data_list: (That's really nice...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cherishing what you love, spending peaceful moments, unwinding.
Seeing her like this was wonderful, and made me wish I could do the same...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something caught my eye, so I walked over
and picked it up.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Did you find something to buy as well, Trainer?
What sort of item is it?
choice_data_list: Um... this one.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My, look at all those tiny spines...
What a lovely little cactus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The item I had picked up and immediately decided to buy
was a tiny cactus planted in a palm-sized pot.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Something about it just felt really soothing.
Yeah. There's something really comforting about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Indeed, its spines are almost like downy fuzz... It gives such a warm feeling.
choice_data_list: I wonder if you can make terrariums with cacti too?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is entirely possible. Many people spread white sand
to create a refreshingly cool impression.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, perhaps I might try that myself someday.
Arranging a variety of cacti with differing colors and shapes...
choice_data_list: Huh, sounds like it'd have a totally different charm from moss.
Oh, that sounds like it'd have a completely different charm from moss.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am quite curious to see what unique appeal
will reveal itself once I actually begin raising them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she let her imagination wander, her shoulders visibly relaxed,
showing a charming side fitting for a girl her age.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, soothed by our little green companions,
we began making our way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had been so long since I experienced such a peaceful moment.
Time felt like it was flowing much more slowly than usual...
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, I had a really fulfilling day.
Thanks to you, I've had a truly fulfilling day.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, you merely accompanied me on my errands.
It was truly nothing extraordinary.
choice_data_list: No, really. The idea of taking a break hadn't even crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained the situation to her—how I had originally planned to work today,
and how that was usually how I spent my days off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And how seeing the way Air Messiah clearly separated work from rest
had a genuinely positive impact on me.
choice_data_list: I think I want to start following your example from now on.
I think I'd like to start following your example from now on.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Oh, my—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing you say that brings me great joy.
It feels as though you are praising not just me, but my mother as well.
choice_data_list: Huh? ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In truth, my perspective regarding rest and recuperation
is largely something I learned from my mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mother—she believed like this:

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Taking meaningful rest allows both body and mind to truly relax.
And that, in turn, is what leads to delivering one's best performance.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Which is precisely why an athlete must never
neglect their rest.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I strive to follow that philosophy as well.
So that I may deliver peak performance and reach even greater heights.
choice_data_list: I think that's a wonderful mindset.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I agreed, I realized that this principle
applied just as much to Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If my own performance slips due to poor rest,
it will inevitably affect how I guide my trainee.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And if that happens, it could even hurt her race results...
choice_data_list: (I can never let that happen. Not ever.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
?
Trainer, you have quite a troubled look on your face. Is something the matter...?
choice_data_list: Ah, no, it's nothing.
Ah, no, it's nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting proper rest and relaxing is also for Air Messiah's sake.
Thanks to her, I managed to learn a valuable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next morning—as soon as I woke up, the tiny cactus caught my eye.
An unconscious smile crept onto my face, easing my tension.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to cherish little moments like these. And more than ever, I resolved
to be the best support I could possibly be for Air Messiah.
